name: Sweet Potato Fritters with Greek Yogurt & Raspberry Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and coarsely grate sweet potatoes. Place in a medium bowl along with eggs, flour, cinnamon, and salt, then stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g sweet potatoes
4 eggs
1 tsp cinnamon, ground
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry raspberries. Place in a small saucepan along with maple syrup.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (170 g) pkgs raspberries
2 tsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Set pan over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until raspberries are warmed through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat and lightly crush raspberries with a potato masher or fork to create a semi-smooth sauce.
To serve, divide fritters between plates, then top with yogurt and raspberry sauce. Enjoy!
